Set a daily word count goal - A page a day is just about 300 words. You do not need to write a whole lot.

Set the same place every time when you write a book

Set a total word count
Give yourself weekly deadlines
Get early feedback - Nothing hurts even worse than writing a publication and after that needing to have to rewrite it since you didn't allow no one has a look at it.

Land a traditional publisher who will offer you a book contract.
Hire a service to help you publish your book. 
Self-publish by the author: self publishing may be harder to do but you'll earn more for every book you sell.

In a traditional publishing arrangement, the publisher pays you for the right to publish your work. Traditional publishers assume all costs and pay you an advance and royalties. You must persuade them to accept your work by delivering an effective pitch or manuscript.
